name: TraeCNclaw
description: Delegate IDE tasks from OpenClaw to a local TraeCNclaw instance that drives the TraeCN desktop app.

tools.name: traecn_capabilities
tools.description: Return a compact agent-facing catalog of commands, endpoints, models, settings sections, and token-saving call order.

tools.name: traecn_command_set
tools.description: List the production command set OpenClaw can use to control TraeCN.

tools.name: traecn_preflight
tools.description: Return compact status, readiness, queue, dialog, and optional command confirmation state before operating TraeCN.

tools.name: traecn_command
tools.description: Execute a preset TraeCN command through the local TraeCNclaw gateway, including confirmed restart_trae_debug recovery.

params.description: Command parameters. See traecn_command_set for required and optional keys.

tools.name: traecn_vibe_workflow
tools.description: Run an unattended TraeCN vibe coding workflow with background queue tracking and auto-continued follow-up steps.

task.description: The initial vibe coding task to delegate to TraeCN

steps.description: Follow-up workflow steps to auto-continue after the initial task

followupTasks.description: Alias for steps; included for delegate_async workflow compatibility

projectPath.description: Project path TraeCN should work inside

chatId.description: Optional OpenClaw chat id for notifications

includeProcessText.description: Include process/thinking information in collected results

reviewRequired.description: Mark workflow checkpoints reviewable while auto-continuing them

fallbackModels.description: Ordered fallback models to probe while the selected model is queued

autoModelFallback.description: Use gateway default fallback model list while queued

modelProbeIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between fallback model probes

notifyUrl.description: Webhook URL to notify when workflow state changes

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Optional local queue wait cap; omit to wait indefinitely

tools.name: traecn_plan_operation
tools.description: Create a dry side-effect, risk, and preflight plan before executing a TraeCN command.

command.description: Command you intend to execute, e.g. settings_set or approve_dialog

forceConfirm.description: Force user confirmation even for lower-risk commands

tools.name: traecn_status
tools.description: Check if TraeCNclaw gateway is reachable and TraeCN automation is ready.

allowAutoStart.description: Allow automatically starting TraeCN if not running

tools.name: traecn_new_chat
tools.description: Create a new chat in TraeCN and switch the UI to it.

allowAutoStart.description: Allow automatically starting TraeCN if not running

tools.name: traecn_delegate
tools.description: Delegate an IDE task to TraeCN desktop app and return the AI response.

task.description: The task description to delegate to TraeCN

projectPath.description: Path to the project to open in TraeCN

sessionId.description: Existing session ID to use instead of creating a new one

chatId.description: Optional OpenClaw chat id for notifications

allowAutoStart.description: Allow automatically starting TraeCN if not running

includeProcessText.description: Include process/thinking information in the response

waitForQueue.description: If true, queue the task when the model is busy; if false, return queue info immediately

background.description: Queue immediately in the gateway background worker

asyncPoll.description: Always use async delegate path and return taskId for caller-managed polling

reviewRequired.description: Return successful results as review checkpoints before finalizing

autoContinue.description: Automatically approve reviewable follow-up workflow checkpoints

followupTasks.description: Follow-up tasks for unattended workflow continuation

notifyUrl.description: Webhook URL to notify when async task state changes

fallbackModels.description: Ordered model candidates to probe while queued

autoModelFallback.description: Use gateway default fallback model list while queued

modelProbeIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between background fallback model probes

tools.name: traecn_switch_mode
tools.description: Switch TraeCN between SOLO and IDE modes.

allowAutoStart.description: Allow automatically starting TraeCN if not running

tools.name: traecn_switch_model
tools.description: Switch the AI model used by TraeCN.

model.description: The model name to switch to

tools.name: traecn_queue_status
tools.description: Check if the current TraeCN AI model is queued or busy.

projectPath.description: Path to the project to open

tools.name: traecn_chat
tools.description: Trigger a task via the trae-cn chat CLI without waiting for an AI response.

addFile.description: File path to add as context

tools.name: traecn_update_self
tools.description: Update the TraeCNclaw plugin to the latest version.

force.description: Force update even if already up to date

tools.name: traecn_approve
tools.description: Detect and approve/dismiss dialogs in TraeCN. Auto-detects dialog type and clicks the appropriate button.

action.description: "auto" (default) auto-detects best action. trust/allow/confirm for positive actions, deny/cancel/dismiss to reject.

waitForDialog.description: If true, waits up to 30 seconds for a dialog to appear before approving.

tools.name: traecn_dialog_status
tools.description: Check if there is a pending dialog (restricted mode, permission request, confirmation) in TraeCN.

slashCommands.description: Create a new chat and delegate a task to TraeCN, returning only the final response
Create a new chat and delegate a task to TraeCN, returning the full output including process information
